ns2:section.sectionText: Examines the transition from a world of peasants, artisans, and aristocrats to the democratic, industrial world that we inhabit today. What have been the driving forces behind the birth of the modern world? How did liberty, equality, and fraternity become its watchwords, and what has been their fate: These are key questions that the course will address. Another major them will be the interaction between Europe and the rest of the world.
